summary: PASS. P0=0, P1=0, P2=0, P3=0. The audit covered all 10 changed files and the full code-style/review-memory rule set. R34/R9 pass because all three test_package executables link the installed sep package and call real public APIs; the CI destructive negative test also proved that removing package include/lib content makes the tests fail. R8/R19/R40 pass: no source patch, no platform macro injection in the recipe, no stub, archive or prebuilt artifact is submitted, and SEP is not a deep graphics/UI/multimedia/hardware/system-integration library. The official HTTPS source archive checksum was independently downloaded and verified as a0c8324ab66ee716080472cb212e4303e6c3e33b0d43763075b20d4cab793b25. Recipe checks pass: package name/version/path agree, all four settings exist, os validation uses (Linux, OHOS), compiler selection comes from tools.build:compiler_executables, package_type is shared-library, cpp_info exports sep plus system lib m, and the package has no external Conan dependency or CLI output. R51 passes: upstream inventory found 26 pytest binding cases plus the two official C-library validation stages; host baseline was 28/28, both C stages run again during the OHOS build, and three installed-package tests raise the adapted total to 31 with one explicit HarmonyOS/AArch64 test. W2/PF7/PF8/PF9 pass: the diff is confined to archives/s/sep/1.4.1, uses an official PyPI release URL, includes the required recipe/conandata/test source/MANIFEST files, and the branch is exactly feat/sep-1.4.1. No placeholders, credentials, absolute paths, generated build files, logs, state files or unrelated framework changes are present.
